column1: I am so incredibly happy and proud today! Finally cracked my college coding hackathon and won the first prize! 😊 #Success #Coding
It's 3 o'clock at night and I can't sleep at all. The pressure from exams is so much that my head is about to burst.
Everything feels so heavy and hopeless lately. It feels like no matter how hard I try, I am stuck in a dark tunnel with no way out.
Just ordered a warm cup of coffee and sitting by the window. Outside weather is calm and normal. A quiet afternoon.
I am feeling extremely anxious about my technical job interview tomorrow. My hands are shaking and I can't focus on revision.
Spent a wonderful weekend with my family after a very long time. Feeling deeply energized, grateful, and loved. ❤️
Office deadlines are piling up and the manager keeps pushing for more metrics. I am constantly exhausted, burned out, and highly stressed.
Woke up early today, completed my morning workout routine, and now moving towards the library to complete my data science assignments.
I feel so lonely and isolated in this new city. It feels like nobody actually cares or understands what I am going through.
The street food near the campus was okay today. Just a regular, uneventful day with routine college lectures.
